newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 3.50-4.00 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 3.50-4.00 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar hovered in a low 3.50-4.00 percent range on Saturday with few signs that the latest CD auction had any impact in draining excess funds, dealers said.
Bankers said banks did not subscribe heavily in Saturday's 15 million dinar ($21 million dinar) CD (certificate of deposit) issue.
They said overnight rates were likely to remain at low levels for the rest of the week unless major bank borrowing surfaced in the coming few days to push rates higher.
The market's excess liquidity sent rates tumbling last week to a 4.00 percent average from above 8.00 percent in the previous period.
Rates hovered in a wider 3.00-3.75 percent range at end of weekly trade on Thursday.
